# MachineCurve

> MachineCurve is a comprehensive machine learning education platform offering in-depth tutorials and explanations for modern ML frameworks and techniques.

MachineCurve provides practical guides and conceptual explanations for machine learning practitioners using popular frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Keras. The site covers everything from foundational neural network concepts to advanced architectures and computer vision applications.

## Key Topics

- PyTorch
- TensorFlow
- Keras
- Deep Learning
- Neural Networks
- Transformers
- Computer Vision
- ResNet
- Scikit-learn
- HuggingFace
- GPU/TPU
- Decision Trees
- StyleGAN
- Python

## Getting Started

- [MachineCurve.com | Machine Learning Tutorials, Machine Learning Explained](https://machinecurve.com/index2.php): Hub for ML tutorials covering PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras and foundational machine learning concepts
